ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all shareholders, directors, beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against the VFIU domestic watchlist, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, and applicable Commonwealth and EU sanctions regimes; enhanced due diligence is legally required for any person qualifying as a politically exposed person under the AML/CFT Act No. 7 of 2017, including verification of source of funds and senior management approval of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be in English or in Latin-script transliteration; International Company names must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', or 'Inc.'; names in non-Latin scripts are not accepted; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered entity or reserved name and must not imply any governmental, royal, or official sponsorship.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed name, the applicant or licensed registered agent must file a written appeal with the VFSC Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds of appeal and attaching the original name search receipt; the Registrar must issue a written determination within 21 days; if the appeal is denied, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review within 30 days; a name reservation may be renewed for additional 30-day periods upon payment of the applicable statutory renewal fee prior to expiry, provided the name remains available.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A fully virtual office is not permissible for a Vanuatu International Company; the company must maintain a physical registered office in Port Vila supplied and supervised by a VFSC-licensed registered agent; the registered agent's physical address may be used as the statutory service address, but no independent virtual-only office arrangement will satisfy the statutory registered office requirement or the substance expectations of the VFSC and VFIU.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate for this low-risk digital publishing activity, estimated at 20-35% likelihood of an unannounced on-site visit or inspection by the VFSC or VFIU during the first three years of operation; the likelihood increases materially if adverse media, PEP status, sanctions screening hits, or unusual transactional volumes are identified.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Act No. 32 of 1993), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2013 - s. 6 (incorporation by memorandum and articles of association), s. 13 (registered office and registered agent), and the related provisions on directors and officers; read together with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission fee regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company accompanied by the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, lodged by a VFSC-licensed registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Nil minimum paid-up capital. The Act permits shares of no par value, does not require the authorized capital to be fully subscribed or paid at incorporation, and imposes no escrow-account or capital-verification requirement; the founding subscriber's allotment is recorded in the statutory register of members.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the allotment of one hundred ordinary shares of no par value to the founding subscriber, as recorded in the Memorandum of Association, is hereby approved and confirmed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be established at the registered agent's office in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and that agent is authorized to accept service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Director and Secretary named in the Register of Officers are hereby appointed to hold office until removed or resigned. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Director is authorized to open and operate bank accounts, engage payment processors, execute commercial contracts, and manage the digital magazine publishing business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and Name Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-approved registered agent acting under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a VFSC-licensed registered agent domiciled in Port Vila. Submit three ranked proposed company names with the suffix IC, INC, or LIMITED. The agent verifies availability against the VFSC register of prohibited or identical names and obtains written name-clearance confirmation before constitutional documents are drafted.
required_dossiers: Completed incorporation order form
Certified passport copies of the subscriber, director and secretary
Professional reference letter from a bank, legal or accounting firm
Proposed company name in order of preference
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused as undesirable or confusingly similar, the agent lodges an alternative name on the same day; a formal refusal may be contested by written submission to the VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent with witness or notarial attestation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association adopting the model clauses, including authorized capital of 1,000 shares of no par value, limited liability of members, and officer indemnity. The subscriber executes the constitutional documents in the presence of a witness or notary, and the director and secretary sign written consents to act.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as director and secretary
Statutory declaration of the subscriber
Registered office consent of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any drafting defect is cured by amending the articles before filing; if the amendment is material, the VFSC requires a fresh execution page signed by the subscriber.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgement of Statutory Filing with VFSC and Payment of Registration Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Corporate Services Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the executed documents through the VFSC counter or electronic window and settles the official registration fee of USD 250 in Vanuatu Vatu. VFSC verifies the constitutional documents, company name, officer consents and agent authorization, and the company acquires separate legal personality upon issuance of the certificate.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name clearance confirmation
Consents to act and registered agent consent
Proof of payment of official filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: VFSC queries are answered by the registered agent within 14 days; a defective filing is re-lodged with a note of amendments without loss of the original priority date where the defect is minor.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Opening of Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing a unique registration number. The directors open the statutory register of members, register of directors and secretaries, and register of charges; issue share certificates to the founding subscriber; and adopt the first board resolution approving share allotment, the registered office, and officer appointments.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association as registered
Register of Members
Register of Directors and Secretaries
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Typographical errors in the certificate are corrected by VFSC on a rectification application supported by the original certificate and a covering letter from the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Merchant Payment-Rail Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial banks and payment processors (Stripe, Google AdSense)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The director submits the Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, a certificate of good standing not older than 14 days, and the due diligence file to the selected bank for corporate account opening. In parallel, the company completes merchant onboarding with Stripe and Google AdSense using the corporate legal name, the VFSC registration details, and the Vanuatu registered office address. No Vanuatu business license or physical inspection applies to offshore digital publishing revenue of an International Company.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Passport copies and proof of address of the beneficial owner
Bank reference and source of funds declaration
Website registration, subscription pricing sheet, and payment processing plan for KYC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional KYC or sanctions screening explanations, supply a source-of-funds letter from the subscriber's principal bank and a brief economic activity statement confirming zero local physical operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - no industrial undertakings. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is the sole regulatory authority for the International Company; no industrial licensing board or manufacturing permit regime applies to a digital magazine publishing portal.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required. The International Company is exempt from the Vanuatu Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap 235] and from import or export licensing for non-resident digital publishing and sponsored media placement activities. The Certificate of Incorporation constitutes the sole operating authorization.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Republic of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - administrative registration only. A pure digital publishing operation with no physical premises, construction works, or land disturbance is not a listed EIA activity under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act [Cap 283]; no environmental impact assessment or environmental permit is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: None applicable. The operation generates no wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste. Compliance is limited to lawful disposal of electronic equipment under the Waste Management Act [Cap 285], and any third-party data center used must adhere to host-country emissions and energy standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable - no commercial premises are occupied. Fire safety certification, structural load inspections, and workplace health clearances are not triggered. The sole director may elect to maintain a home-office declaration for insurance purposes, and the company should apply appropriate data privacy controls over subscriber personal data as part of its digital governance obligations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury (Ministry of Finance and Economic Management), Port Vila, Vanuatu; official portal: www.customs.gov.vu (tax administration contact) and www.vfsc.vu (International Company registration authority).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu International Company (IC) is not subject to income tax and is not required to obtain a national taxpayer identification number (TIN) or VAT registration. The IC obtains a Certificate of Incorporation from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through a licensed registered agent. If a tax exemption certificate is desired, the registered agent submits a statutory declaration and Form IC-9 to the VFSC, which issues a Certificate of Tax Exemption under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. This certificate confirms exemption from all taxes, duties, and charges for a minimum of 20 years from incorporation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available. International Companies automatically qualify for statutory tax exemption under Section 125 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. No entity-level or pass-through election is necessary. Hybrid mismatch treatment is not recognized; Vanuatu has no anti-hybrid rules within the tax code.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no VAT/GST; customs duties only apply to physical imports; digital goods and services are not subject to indirect tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. No turnover-based indirect tax registration obligation applies to an International Company deriving offshore digital publishing and advertising income.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable - Vanuatu does not mandate electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, API data exchange, or digital stamping for services. Standard commercial invoicing is acceptable. As no indirect tax is levied, no e-fiscal invoice reporting is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - Vanuatu does not impose VAT/GST on goods or services, including exported digital magazine subscriptions and sponsored media placements. Any export of digital content is entirely outside the indirect tax net; therefore, no zero-rating claim or refund mechanism exists.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export zero-rating or VAT clawback regime exists. However, the VFSC may cancel an International Company's certificate if it engages in local business activities or submits misleading exemption declarations. Penalties under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] may include fines up to VUV 200,000 and, for directors, up to VUV 50,000 plus three months' imprisonment. Retained tax exemption may be revoked for any deemed domestic trading activity.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125], is the central bank and delegated exchange-control authority; it administers the Exchange Control Act [Cap 60] on behalf of the Minister of Finance, licenses and supervises commercial banks under the Banking Act [Cap 62], and enforces the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2017 for banks. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) registers and supervises the International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] but holds no foreign-exchange or monetary authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) trades under a managed float anchored to an undisclosed external-currency basket (USD, AUD, EUR, JPY) with RBV intervention, and is fully convertible for current-account transactions, including digital advertising royalties and platform payouts. For the VU_IC the convertibility position is enhanced: the International Companies Act [Cap 222] disapplies the Exchange Control Act [Cap 60] in respect of international companies, so capital-account entries (paid-up share capital, shareholder loans, dividend remittances, liquidation proceeds, management fees) are unrestricted, may be denominated in any currency, and require no RBV approval. There is zero profit-remittance friction: Vanuatu levies no income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax on dividends, interest, or royalties, and no mandatory conversion of foreign receipts into VUV applies to the IC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender or conversion obligation exists for the VU_IC. Unlike resident exporters subject to exchange-control repatriation practice, the IC's offshore-origin advertising and subscription revenue is outside the Exchange Control Act [Cap 60] and may be retained in USD, EUR, or AUD in the Vanuatu bank account or cleared to offshore accounts without time limits or conversion ratios. Even under the domestic resident-company regime, the RBV does not impose a fixed surrender percentage; export proceeds are typically held in foreign-currency export accounts at a licensed bank. The VU_IC's practical compliance duty is limited to bank-level CDD evidence of the provenance of AdSense and Stripe-sourced receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: BSP Corporate USD/AUD/VUV multi-currency transaction account with interest-bearing treasury sweep and corporate internet banking host-to-host
ANZ Transactive multi-currency account (USD/NZD/AUD/VUV) with standalone USD nostro overlay for AdSense wire receipts
BRED Corporate EUR/USD/VUV account plus negotiable-certificate-of-deposit money-market placement
NBV VUV-denominated current account with restricted USD operation overlay for non-resident-owned entities

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium feasibility. Vanuatu has no dedicated e-money-institution licensing regime; the Financial Dealership Act 2000 covers foreign-exchange dealing and money transmission but does not create an EMI licence usable for digital wallet issuance, so offshore EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) generally reject Vanuatu-domiciled ICs or cannot settle VUV. Legally, an unlicensed offshore EMI collecting money from the IC's customers would engage in unlicensed money-service business within Vanuatu, an RBV enforcement risk. Practical architecture: retain the Vanuatu commercial bank as the legal treasury account and use Payoneer or Airwallex only as a USD receiving wallet for AdSense and affiliate payouts, with same-day MT103 sweeps into the BSP or ANZ account; the contractual merchant-of-record remains the IC. Note that Stripe has no Vanuatu node and cannot be the direct acquiring rail for the IC; the IC should rely on AdSense wire transfer via the correspondent-banked USD account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The AML/CFT Act 2017 and Banking Act [Cap 62] impose full CDD and beneficial-ownership verification but do not mandate in-branch appearance. In practice BSP and BRED accept fully remote onboarding: (i) certified passport copies, (ii) VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and registered-agent certificate, (iii) UBO register extract, and (iv) a video interview with the signing director and any shareholder holding 25% or more. ANZ generally requires an augmented packet with notarization or apostille and may summon a director for an interview at a Vanuatu or Australia branch. NBV effectively mandates physical attendance by the director or an authorized representative at the Port Vila branch. The defensible minimum is a live video interview of at least one natural-person director, with the other UBOs producing notarized identity documents and a registered-agent board-minute approving the signatory mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company incorporated in a zero-tax jurisdiction without demonstrated economic substance, triggering PEP or shell-structure alerts on the bank's underwriting score
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and current register extract; licensed registered-agent certificate; board resolution appointing the Vanuatu registered agent as process agent; digital-publishing business plan, live website and magazine portal URLs, and advertiser contracts; six months of Google AdSense and platform IRR statements demonstrating genuine operating revenue; office or co-working access letter if any director operates from Port Vila.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity, nominee shareholding, or historical bearer-share concern in the IC structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed statutory beneficial-ownership register under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; full corporate organigram with passport copies of every natural person holding 25% or more; signed declarations of non-PEP status for all UBOs; nominee disclosure agreements, if appointee directors are used, naming the nominator; written confirmation that no bearer shares are outstanding and that the share register is deposited with the VFSC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: US-sourced advertising revenue entering through third-party payout rails (AdSense or Stripe) flagged as cross-border virtual-asset or money-service adjacency
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Google AdSense publisher statements mapping payout ID to the IC's bank details; platform-level traffic and earnings dashboards; direct insertion-order and programmatic ad contracts; consent letters from counterparties for AML enquiries; source-of-funds explanation memorandum showing the flow from advertiser to Google to AdSense payout to the Vanuatu USD correspondent account; evidence that no crypto or high-risk payment instruments are used.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No local tax identification number and absence of any tax registration, leading to CRS and FATCA self-certification failure at account opening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Vanuatu International Tax Compliance (Common Reporting Standard) Act 2020 compliant CRS self-certification (entity classification as Financial Non-Tax-Resident Entity or Passive NFE as applicable); OECD tax-residence certificates of all UBOs; no-TIN explanation letter citing the nil income-tax regime of Vanuatu; registered-agent undertaking to file the annual AEOI and CRS return through the RBV portal; signed FATCA entity classification and GIIN declaration if US account signatories exist.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions-screening hits or reputational concern around digital media content distributed to embargoed territories
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative OFAC, EU, and UN screening results for all publishers, advertisers, and payment beneficiaries; geo-blocking policy and advertising-exclusion logs demonstrating no revenue from sanctioned states; editorial compliance statement excluding terrorist or sanctions-prohibited content; list of existing DSP and SSP partners; undertaking to notify the bank within 24 hours of any new high-risk counterparty.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injection must settle by SWIFT MT103 from the UBO's sourced bank account with reference exactly: 'Share capital subscription, International Company [company number], International Companies Act Cap 222, Exchange Control Act exempt'; recommended minimum USD 50,000 for two months of operating runway. Routing: UBO bank to the Vanuatu bank's USD correspondent (ANZ uses its international USD correspondent chain; BSP uses Westpac or ANZ nostro) to the VUV or USD domestic credit to the IC account. Include the IC's full registered name, VFSC registration number, and beneficiary account details; avoid third-party cash or crypto funding. File the allotment resolution and share register with the VFSC within 28 days; no RBV investment approval or Foreign Investment Registration Certificate is required for offshore digital-media operations. For traceability under Stage-5 adversarial review, require the issuing bank to transmit the SWIFT UETR and the Vanuatu bank to issue a confirmation of credit referencing the BPM6 purpose code for equity capital other than reinvestment of earnings.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Digital-magazine disbursements (contributor royalties, photographer fees, cloud hosting, media-buy invoices) clear via the following rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for all bank-to-bank settlements, embedding the IC's registered name and beneficiary IBAN with purpose text 'Royalties - intellectual property' or 'Advertising and market research'; (2) MT202 COV solely for beneficiary-bank covering transfers on high-value settlements above USD 50,000; (3) commercial letters of credit are inapplicable to intangible digital content, so open-account settlement with VAT and GST-exempt invoices is used; (4) batched sub-USD 10,000 remittances may route through the BSP or ANZ corporate API or an approved PSP (Payoneer or MassPay) for global freelancer payouts, provided the PSP executes an MT103 backhaul into the Vanuatu account; (5) VUV domestic payments clear T+1 through the Vanuatu Automated Clearing House. All outbound wires must carry the UETR and the registered-agent-approved invoice backup to pre-empt bank reviews.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable OTC foreign-exchange forwards (VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, VUV/EUR) with tenors up to 12 months offered by BSP, ANZ, and BRED treasury desks under bilateral ISDA-style master agreements; no RBV approval required for the IC given the exchange-control exemption
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) against VUV referencing the RBV published mid-rate, settled in USD, for treasury where the IC books liquidity offshore
FX swaps (spot and forward combination) for treasury warehousing between USD advertising receipts and VUV local-cost disbursements

Bespoke cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV, EUR/VUV) available on a back-to-back basis through ANZ or BRED for tenors exceeding 12 months where advertiser revenue and cost streams are in different currencies

OTC exotic options (digital and barrier USD/VUV) are contractually permissible for the IC but are generally declined by local bank credit committees, so offshore ISDA execution through the parent group's treasury is the operative vehicle

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form IC-AR) under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation; the annual renewal window closes on the date immediately preceding the anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VT 20,000 (approx. USD 180); if unfiled and unpaid for 90 days after written notice, VFSC may strike the company off the International Companies Register; administrative strike-off occurs after 6 months of continuous default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Continuation Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC through the VFSC-licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the incorporation anniversary, aligned with the annual return filing window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a VFSC-licensed registered agent and registered office in Vanuatu for 28 consecutive days triggers VFSC administrative action and ultimately deregistration of the International Company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License and Renewal Fee Payment for Tax-Exempt International Company Status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation; VFSC grants a 60-day grace period ending on 31 December of the renewal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Additional late fee of USD 100 per month or partial month applies; non-payment for 90 days after the due date permits administrative strike-off, forfeiture of corporate name, and loss of limited-liability protection.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Automatic audit exemption applies unless the International Company exceeds USD 500,000 in net assets or annual turnover, has more than 25 beneficial shareholders, or is designated by VFSC as a higher AML/CFT risk; in such cases, a Vanuatu-licensed auditor must conduct an independent statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted for use in Vanuatu, or a simplified cash-basis bookkeeping framework for exempt non-resident International Companies; exempted companies do not publicly file financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must keep and update registers of members, directors, and charges at the registered office or with the registered agent. With the annual return, the directors must sign a confirmation stating that all share transfers occurring during the preceding year were recorded in the register of members and any resulting changes in beneficial ownership were included in the VFSC annual return update. Failure to file the annual UBO confirmation with the registered agent and VFSC is an offense under the International Companies Act.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800 - 4,200 (only where audit exemption thresholds are exceeded)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax and stamp duty for International Companies under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. The only recurring state charge is the annual VFSC registration/license fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return for International Company (Form AR-IC) filed through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission e-Registration portal at https://www.vfsc.vu
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the anniversary of the date of incorporation, extended to the next business day if the due date falls on a non-business day.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered company name as shown in the certificate of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact legal name; do not use trade names or website domain names.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International Company registration number assigned by the VFSC Registrar
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Transcribe the registration number precisely from the certificate of incorporation; any discrepancy may delay acceptance.
Provide the full physical address maintained by the licensed registered agent; a P.O. Box alone is not sufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed registered agent name and license number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident beneficial owner must ensure the agent confirms its current licence status before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of continued tax-exempt status and no local Vanuatu business activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must instruct the registered agent to confirm the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents or derived income from Vanuatu sources; otherwise the exemption may be lost.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership schedule listing each natural person with significant control
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose full legal names, residential addresses, nationality, and percentage of control for all ultimate beneficial owners; failure is an offence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of VUV 25,000 plus VUV 10,000 per month or incomplete month of continued default. Non-payment of the annual fee may lead to strike-off from the Register after 90 days, requiring a court restoration order with outstanding fees, restoration costs and potential director disqualification.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu does not impose any withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company, and no advance corporation tax or dividend tax exists.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network. Because no source-country withholding tax is levied, no treaty relief application or reduced rate clearance is required in Vanuatu. The IC should simply provide a certificate of good standing and a declaration of non-residence to the recipient’s financial institution; the non-resident shareholder then claims any foreign tax credit or participation exemption in its own tax residence jurisdiction, supported by the IC’s certificate of incorporation and extract from the VFSC register.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Vanuatu withholding rate: 0% for both IP royalties and debt interest paid by an International Company. No DTA-reduced rate is applicable as Vanuatu imposes no source withholding; the non-resident recipient must assess any tax obligation under its domestic law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — no VUV-denominated threshold exists because Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax and has no statutory transfer pricing documentation regime for International Companies. Notwithstanding, cross-border arm’s-length contracts and substance documentation should be maintained to defend against foreign revenue authority challenges.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu’s International Companies (Economic Substance) Act applies only to specified relevant activities: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters and holding operations. Digital magazine publishing and sponsored media placements are not a listed relevant activity; therefore no Vanuatu economic substance test is triggered. However, every International Company must still maintain adequate accounting records and file beneficial ownership information with the VFSC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Improper Tax Avoidance in Foreign Jurisdiction
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company’s 0% Vanuatu tax status to conceal the profits of a digital magazine business whose management and control are actually exercised in a high-tax jurisdiction, while failing to satisfy substance or tax residence rules in that jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In Vanuatu, the IC may be struck off and directors disqualified; in the foreign jurisdiction, outcomes typically include upward transfer pricing adjustments, penalty taxes of up to 200% of the underpaid tax, and criminal tax charges with substantial fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil where the IC is a mere façade; directors may be personally liable for restitution of diverted profits, travel bans may be imposed pending investigation, and imprisonment of up to 14 years is possible for serious tax fraud in major onshore centres.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the digital magazine portal purely as a pass-through invoice shell with no real staff, no physical assets, no board meetings, and no accounting records, while using nominee directors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act, failure to maintain proper books and records is an offence; VFSC may strike off the IC and regulatory bodies in financial corridors may impose fines of up to VUV 5,000,000 for opaque shell structures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors are civilly liable for false declarations and may be ordered to repay withdrawn funds; AML authorities may impose travel bans, and imprisonment of up to 5 years may result for making false statutory statements.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the beneficial ownership register, or allowing undisclosed control structures through bearer-like arrangements for the digital magazine company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu’s Beneficial Ownership Act, late or missing filings attract penalties of VUV 100,000 per month per entity, and the VFSC may impose civil penalties of up to VUV 10,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and registered agents may be jointly and severally liable for unpaid fines; senior officers can be disqualified, and imprisonment not exceeding 10 years is available for money-laundering predicate offences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresentation to Financial Intermediaries / Payment Processors
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely declaring on payment processor or advertising engine applications that the company has substantive business operations in Vanuatu when it does not, or routing sponsorship revenue to evade processor terms and anti-fraud rules.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil liability under contract and anti-fraud statutes; payment processors may permanently withhold funds; Vanuatu regulators may impose AML fines and the foreign platform may refer the matter for criminal fraud investigation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false compliance declarations are personally liable for clawbacks and restitution to the payment processor, and may face criminal prosecution for wire fraud or internet fraud with imprisonment of up to 20 years in jurisdictions such as the United States.
